title: cicer paucijugum
intro: Cicer paucijugum, commonly known as the few-leaved chickpea or Broom Raape, is a plant species in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asian cultures, for its health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Cicer paucijugum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
